metaDescription: Order custom recycled shorts in bulk. Eco-friendly branding for your team or event. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Recycled shorts are a smart choice for businesses that prioritize sustainability without sacrificing comfort or performance. Made from post-consumer recycled polyester, these shorts reduce waste while delivering the same durability and moisture-wicking properties as virgin materials. Whether you are outfitting a corporate wellness team or supplying uniforms for a community event, custom recycled shorts let you promote your brand and environmental values together. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish.
